verdict.rationale: Termius records session logs automatically for every host and syncs them across devices and the team. Users can bookmark a session to keep it for future reference, which implies a default retention period that the user can override per session. That is only a glancing form of retention control. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, a way to delete logs, vault or account data, the ability to turn off automatic log collection or sync, and any independent corroboration.
